snippet.title: Knights of the Crusades | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Knights of the Crusades is AVAILABLE NOW in Early Access on Steam!
Begin your campaign on Steam today ➤ https://bit.ly/KnightsofCrusades

A medieval RTS sandbox where your legacy is forged in faith and steel. Command real-time battles, manage your cities, and shape history across Europe and the Holy Land.

🛡️ Real-time tactical warfare
🏰 City-building + resource management
🙏 Found a custom Holy Order or lead the legendary Templars
🗺️ Face dynamic events, holy wars, and excommunication

Whether you rise as a crusading knight or a powerful Muslim ruler, every decision will shape the fate of the First Crusade. Master logistics, tactics, diplomacy, and faith in a game built for long-term growth and player-driven storytelling.

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
